lines.t: Hatsune Miku holds a leek because of a meme.

full.credit: Clips: yoyo; Neorar; Hatsune Miku live (YouTube)

lines.t: Before Miku, a looping animation showed an anime girl spinning a leek to a Finnish song, Ievan Polkka.

full.credit: Clips: yoyo; Neorar; Hatsune Miku live (YouTube)

lines.t: In September 2007, days after Miku came out, a producer called Otomania made her sing it.

full.credit: Clips: yoyo; Neorar; Hatsune Miku live (YouTube)

lines.t: The video showed a tiny Miku spinning a leek. Fans named her Hachune Miku, and the leek stuck forever.

full.credit: Clips: yoyo; Neorar; Hatsune Miku live (YouTube)
